Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).cause: Fungi complex: Phaeomoniella chlamydospora, Phaeoacremonium aleophilum, and Fomitiporia mediterranea
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).symptoms: Leaves display a striking 'tiger-stripe' pattern of chlorosis and necrosis. Berries develop small, dark, sunken spots scattered across the skin, giving them a 'measles' appearance.
treatment: No effective chemical cure exists; surgically remove and burn heavily infected cordons or vines
Apply wound-protectant paste or a biocontrol agent like Trichoderma to pruning cuts immediately to block new fungal entry
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).prevention: Prune vines during dry weather to limit spore transmission, and implement strict vineyard sanitation practices.

Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.symptoms: Dull brown, irregular spots appear on older leaves in late summer, expanding rapidly until the tissue dries up, curls, and causes premature defoliation.
treatment: Apply protective fungicides containing copper or mancozeb post-harvest to prevent late-season leaf drop
Rake, chop, and deeply bury or burn fallen leaves in the autumn to destroy overwintering structures
Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.prevention: Improve the canopy structure using training and trellis systems that optimize airflow and maximize sunlight exposure.

Grape___Black_rot.symptoms: Small, round cream-colored spots with dark brown borders on leaves. Berries rapidly turn into hard, shriveled, wrinkled black 'mummies' covered in tiny fruiting bodies.
treatment: Manually remove and destroy all mummified fruit clusters remaining on the vines or the vineyard floor
Apply systemic fungicides containing myclobutanil or azoxystrobin from early bloom until early summer
Grape___Black_rot.prevention: Maintain a strict weed-free zone directly beneath the vine canopy to dramatically lower ambient relative humidity.

Grape___healthy.symptoms: Leaves are uniform green without patches or blemishes. Fruit clusters grow evenly, displaying firm skins and plump berries.
Grape___healthy.prevention: Ensure routine seasonal pruning, uniform drip irrigation, and balanced nitrogen management.
